title: The CI smoke check compares against the last successful full run, with a labelled fallback
decision: retained, workflow and Python tooling only
code_state: no file under crates/ or tools/perf-baseline/ was modified by this batch
reason_codes: evidence gap 1 of change 0587 ranked highest: the smoke job built its baseline as a byte-copy of the report it had just produced, so it could not detect a regression on any push or pull request
the comparator, the allocator policy and the artifact plumbing already existed end to end; what was missing was a reference artifact from a prior run and the decision logic that binds one

the self-comparison the survey called a working plumbing check had in fact been failing closed for 273 commits, since 126c4a8b2 added tool.allocator_counter_revision to the harness while the checked allocator policy stayed markerless

docs/GOAL.md deliverable 8 forbids making noisy cloud-hosted microbenchmarks a hard merge gate until variance is understood, so the fetched comparison is advisory and only a broken plumbing check fails the job

accepted_evidence.real_harness_legs: two release litchi-perf-baseline-alloc reports, each captured on a clean worktree pinned to CPU 21 at a distinct revision (7082a1a3f and 77220b62b), retained under reports/
accepted_evidence.pipeline_scenarios: five end-to-end runs of the descriptor, fetch-status, select, perf_compare and report steps over those two reports: no artifact, compatible reference, allocation counters raised 10%, reference CPU model changed, reference over another corpus; each with its transcript, selection, comparison, classification and rendered job summary
accepted_evidence.defect_reproduction: the same freshly captured report compared against the base commit's own copy of the allocator policy (ComparisonInputError: baseline.tool does not match the policy tool identity) and against the pinned copy (pass, 2 matched results, 20 compared metrics, 0 regressions)
accepted_evidence.unit_coverage: 121 tests in tools/test_perf_smoke_baseline.py over every branch of the new module, including nine that assert the workflow's wiring textually
accepted_evidence.gate_transcripts: ten gate sections with their tails and exit statuses, plus one pre-existing failure reproduced on the untouched base commit

accepted_costs.no_actions_run: neither gh nor actionlint is installed on this host, so the fetch step's shell has never executed and the workflow was not linted by actionlint; PyYAML, tools/test_perf_workflow_policy.py and nine new wiring tests stand in its place
accepted_costs.first_run_falls_back: no full run has ever published allocator-baseline.json, so the first push after this lands falls back to the labelled plumbing check; the fetched path begins working after the next scheduled or dispatched full run
accepted_costs.policy_strictness: pinning tool_identity.allocator_counter_revision means a report from an older allocator binary can no longer be compared under the checked allocator policy; that is deliberate and is the strict direction
accepted_costs.full_job_cost: the full job pays one extra feature-enabled build of the harness and one 15-sample allocator run; the added wall time on a hosted runner was not measured
accepted_costs.classifier_coupling: the environment-drift classifier matches two literal message prefixes from perf_compare.py; if those change, drift is annotated as an input defect until they are updated

known_gaps.hosted_variance: whether a GitHub-hosted runner's build identity and allocation counters are stable enough between runs for the fetched comparison to fire usefully is unknown; that is exactly the variance deliverable 8 says must be understood before enforcement could change
known_gaps.reference_breadth: the reference is one case, opc_file_eager_open, over one pinned corpus in warm and cold-requested states: twenty deterministic allocation counters, not the 201-result release matrix
known_gaps.fork_pull_requests: whether the read-only token on a fork pull request can list runs and download another run's artifact was not verified

withheld: any latency, cycle, instruction, peak-RSS, cold-cache, range-source, concurrency-scaling, real-producer or cross-platform result
any statement that the smoke comparison constitutes acceptance evidence for an optimization, or that a passing comparison shows performance is unchanged

provenance.host: AMD EPYC 9R45, 32 cores, 123 GiB, Linux 7.0.0-1012-aws, rustc 1.95.0, Python 3.14.4, PyYAML 6.0.3
provenance.note: the two harness legs were built in separate worktrees with their own external CARGO_TARGET_DIR and run pinned to CPU 21; the current leg records revision 77220b62b, the implementation commit that the branch's final commit amends to add this packet
